title: Verify source-level numerical recovery of normalized products (no new κ)
body:
Independently bind the numerical argument of #3709 to its actual integer operations, rounding sites and complete returned packet, supporting the FFT word service in #3787. For every A,C>=1, p>=2 and 1<=ell<p, all admitted disk-valued p-grid records return Q_p(uv/r) modulo X^r+1, where r=2^ell and Q_p truncates components toward zero.

Fourteen source-derived certificate groups establish arbitrary-input arithmetic/rounding DAGs, interval transfers, source plans and complete loop/stream outlines. Written source-bound inductions supply the unbounded loops, interval enclosure, Fourier order and strict scaled error below 1/8. The original numerical estimates remain credited to #3709; this is an independent source refinement, not a new classical FFT lemma.

Base: 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a. #3709 head: 62264289adb01f3ba4930cd0154c75887f96203c. SOURCES.json pins all seven small live inputs by Git blob and SHA256; no predecessor runtime archive is required.

Reproduce (Python 3.12, standard library):
```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/normalized-product-source-refinement
```
Expected: PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE, with 14 certificates and 63 rejecting controls in each normal/optimized run.

Executed: both registered commands, independently rerun on the frozen commit; committed-byte preflight; separate review of the original numerical argument and 22 external branch/flow probes in both modes. Mutants bypass source-hash rejection and cover wrong signs, early truncation, widths, scaling, stage counts, symbolic-control mistakes, disconnected loops and lost output. Review found and repaired defects in the draft checker; no numerical defect in the canonical routine was demonstrated. Complete remote tree matches the tested twelve-file addition.

No new κ. Exact Count operations, unsigned WordProduct, canonical codecs and live-owner/packet contracts remain premises. Unbounded inductions are written mathematics; this is neither a general Python verifier nor a formal-kernel proof. Ownership, exceptional cleanup, the full physical cost/caller join and all five selected assumptions remain outside this result. Open work: compose those lifecycle/cost contracts and formalize the stated inductions.

Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate AI adversarial review. Credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml (#3709/#3787), the retained implementations and classical arithmetic/FFT/interval methods. Apache-2.0.
